# SEESTAR

> A photo voting and star-ranking community where members upload photos, rate them 1–5 stars, and earn milestone stars by holding the #1 spot.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest photos from the SEESTAR community.
- [Trending](/trending): Photos drawing the most votes right now.
- [Top rated](/top): Highest-rated photos with at least 10 votes.
- [Hall of Fame](/hall-of-fame): Photos that earned 3 or more milestone stars.
- [Member Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Members ranked by votes received over day, week, month, year, and all-time.
